mapper.sql: id, login_id, password_hash, display_name, role, email, email_verified, status, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM JL_MEMBER WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND email = #{email}
SELECT FROM JL_MEMBER ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: SELECT jl_member_seq.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO JL_MEMBER (id, login_id, password_hash, display_name, role, email, email_verified) VALUES (#{id}, #{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{role}, #{email}, #{emailVerified})

SELECT jl_email_verification_seq.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO JL_EMAIL_VERIFICATION (id, email, code_hash, expires_at, sent_at, attempt_count) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{sentAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, code_hash, expires_at, sent_at, verified_at, attempt_count FROM JL_EMAIL_VERIFICATION WHERE email = #{email} AND id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM JL_EMAIL_VERIFICATION WHERE email = #{email})
mapper.update: UPDATE JL_EMAIL_VERIFICATION SET verified_at = #{verifiedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND verified_at IS NULL
UPDATE JL_EMAIL_VERIFICATION SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: SELECT jl_password_reset_seq.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO JL_PASSWORD_RESET (id, member_id, code_hash, expires_at, sent_at, attempt_count) VALUES (#{id}, #{memberId}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{sentAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, code_hash, expires_at, sent_at, verified_at, attempt_count FROM JL_PASSWORD_RESET WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM JL_PASSWORD_RESET WHERE member_id = #{memberId})
mapper.update: UPDATE JL_PASSWORD_RESET SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE JL_PASSWORD_RESET SET verified_at = #{verifiedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND verified_at IS NULL
UPDATE JL_MEMBER SET password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE id = #{memberId}
UPDATE JL_MEMBER SET display_name = #{displayName} WHERE id = #{memberId}
UPDATE JL_MEMBER SET role = #{role} WHERE id = #{memberId}
UPDATE JL_MEMBER SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JL_MEMBER_AUDIT (id, member_id, admin_member_id, action_type, previous_status, new_status, reason) VALUES (jl_member_audit_seq.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{adminMemberId}, #{actionType}, #{previousStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.member_id, a.admin_member_id, a.action_type, a.previous_status, a.new_status, a.reason, a.created_at, m.login_id AS member_login_id, admin.login_id AS admin_login_id FROM JL_MEMBER_AUDIT a JOIN JL_MEMBER m ON m.id = a.member_id JOIN JL_MEMBER admin ON admin.id = a.admin_member_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
